business.description: Airan Limited provides IT and IT-enabled services including Cash Management Services, Door Step Banking, Fee Collection, Customer Onboarding eKYC, Cheque Truncation, E-stamping, Document Management, Contact Center Services, Records Management, Address Verification, Credit Verification, Back Office Management, Bookkeeping, Software Development, Self-Managed Superannuation Fund, Financials and Taxation, Data Migration, Payroll Processing, Labour Law Compliance, Digital Document Verification, and Automobile Inspection.

outlook.statement: Moving from executing processes to improving and transforming them by adding intelligence and technology; expanding geographic presence in Asia, UK, and Australia; moving up the value chain to solve business problems through consulting, technology, automation, AI, and operations.

Airan enters FY 2026–27 with a broader ambition to use its experience, technology and international reach to solve larger and more valuable business problems, deepen existing relationships, expand selectively across international markets and progressively increase the contribution of consulting-led, technology-enabled and managed solutions to its overall business, evolving from a trusted outsourcing partner into a trusted transformation partner.
